onbHomeWelcomeBody: Khuluma nanoma ubani, nganoma yiluphi ulimi. Inkulumo yakho iba imibhalo engezansi ebukhoma kanye nezwi elihunyushiwe — ngesikhathi sangempela, kuyo yonke ikholi.
onbHomeStartBody: Setha igama nolimi lwakho, bese ufaka ikhodi yekamelo ukuze uvule ikamelo noma ujoyine elomngani wakho. Cindezela u-Ngena ekamelweni, usungene.
onbHomeTiersBody: I-Standard ikunika imibhalo engezansi ebukhoma nezwi elihunyushiwe ngentengo eshibhile. Amazinga aphezulu ahumusha ngokushesha nangokunemba okuningi. Shintsha noma nini ngaphambi kwekholi.
onbHomeCreditsBody: Amakholi akhokha kusuka ebhalansini yakho ngomzuzu, ngolimi ngalunye lokuhumusha. Faka amakhredithi noma nini nge-Thenga amakhredithi — ibhalansi yakho ihlala ibonakala phezulu.
onbHomeGuestTitle: Ngena ngemvume ukuze ulondoloze umlando wakho
onbHomeGuestBody: Qala ukukhuluma njengesivakashi manje. Ngena ngemvume ukuze ugcine umlando wakho wamakholi, imibhalo namakhredithi kuwo wonke amadivayisi.
onbHomeCtaBody: Yilokho-ke isiqondiso. Setha ulimi lwakho, khetha ikamelo bese uthi sawubona. Vula kabusha lesi siqondiso noma nini ngenkinobho ethi "?".
onbCallIntroBody: Nasi isiqondiso esisheshayo sezilawuli zakho. Ungayeqa noma nini.
onbCallMicBody: Zithulise futhi uzivule. Lapho ukhuluma, amazwi akho ayabhalwa futhi ahunyushelwe wonke umuntu.
onbCallCamBody: Vula noma uvale ikhamera yakho. Umsindo wakho uyaqhubeka noma kunjani.
onbCallCaptionsBody: Bonisa noma ufihle imibhalo engezansi ehunyushiwe phezu kwevidiyo.
onbCallVoiceBody: Vula noma uvale ukuhumusha okukhulunywayo. Kushiye kuvuliwe ukuze uzwe wonke umuntu ngolimi lwakho.
onbCallChatBody: Thumela umlayezo ekamelweni. Konke okuthayiphayo kuhunyushwa ngokuzenzakalelayo kumuntu ngamunye.
onbCallRoomBody: Lokhu kubonisa ikhodi yekamelo lakho nolimi oluzwayo. Thepha ikhodi ukuze uyikopishe futhi uyabelane.
onbCallMoreBody: Ukwabelana ngeskrini, ukuqopha, ibhodi elimhlophe, ukusabela nokunye kuhlala lapha.
onbCallShareBody: Bonisa iwindi noma sonke iskrini sakho ekamelweni ngaphandle kokushiya ikholi.
onbCallInviteBody: Kopisha isixhumanisi sesimemo noma usithumele nge-imeyili ukuze ungenise abanye.
onbCallLeaveBody: Vala ucingo lapho usuqedile. Uzothola isifinyezo esinemibhalo nokokulanda.
onbCallDoneBody: Vula kabusha lesi siqondiso noma nini ngenkinobho ethi "?". Jabulela ingxoxo.
